mechanics.claim: The wave only deals damage and roots on detonation at maximum range, not on contact before then.
mechanics.quote: At maximum range, the wave homes back to '''Swain''' and detonates upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Nevermove can be recast while champions hit are rooted, pulling them; if the root ends or targets escape it before recast, the recast is unavailable.
mechanics.quote: If the root is not applied to, removed or its targets {{tip|blink}} or {{tip|dash}}, the recast becomes unavailable.

mechanics.claim: The recast itself deals no additional damage; it only pulls rooted champions and collects a Soul Fragment from each.
mechanics.quote: '''Swain''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the rooted champions over 290 units and collects a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} from each of them

mechanics.claim: Spell shield will block either the initial detonation or the recast pull, and if it blocks the recast no Soul Fragment is collected.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block either the detonation on the first cast or the pull from the recast.

mechanics.claim: The pull interrupts channels only at the very beginning, without keeping the target stunned for the rest of the movement.
mechanics.quote: The pull will interrupt {{tip|channel|channels}} at the very beginning, but does not keep the target stunned for the rest of the movement.

mechanics.claim: Nevermove's cooldown starts on cast, not when the missile lands or detonates.
